snippet.title: Backrooms: Code Yellow | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Backrooms: Code Yellow is launching September 21st!

Backrooms: Code Yellow is an online 1-6 player co-op game about investigating and collecting data in the Backrooms with your fellow employees.  Explore. Do your job. Return alive.
